scope: Mapped D/S movement and real character/controller ticks; flying with collision disabled isolates camera from terrain. Fixed simulation FPS is not measured rendering performance.
passed_cases: Hold mapped D from a fixed initial world direction
D moves straight while camera settles behind the right turn; pitch is preserved
Releasing movement holds the view; hold mapped S for a reversal
S reverses direction and auto-yaw takes the short arc without a circular movement path
Manual look changes the camera; begin moving during its grace period
Manual look keeps exclusive control while moving during the 1.2-second grace period
Automatic following resumes smoothly after manual look; vertical angle stays manual
Auto-camera can be disabled; begin moving and throwing to check aiming priority
Throwing preserves aim for 0.6 seconds; pause the moving round
Pause holds the camera and resumes without losing input state
Follow resumes after aiming and pause; trigger player defeat
Defeat holds the camera; retry restores normal player collision
Retry reaches ready with a visible healthy player and reset camera input state
